query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_THIRDPARTYRISK (THIRDPARTYRISK_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT THIRDPARTYRISK_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_THIRDPARTYRISK WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT THIRDPARTYRISK_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_THIRDPARTYRISK WHERE THIRDPARTYRISK_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_THIRDPARTYRISK SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE THIRDPARTYRISK_ID = ?
